_about: (0.4.7, gamefixes: the Encounter System) the world's encounters. The Encounter Director (rpg.encounter.Encounters) looks every 'interval' seconds at where the player is - the region and its biome, a road near, whose law, the hour, the weather, the player's level, bounties and honour, what has happened before - and draws one encounter from those eligible, by weight x rarity x the region's density, with cooldowns and a history so nothing repeats too soon. Each encounter is data: when it may happen, who is in it (people, animals, monsters, a carcass, each made from the game's own kinds and kits), where they come in (ahead on the road, hidden in cover, behind, around, far off), and its stages - what each party does, what is said, the choices offered and their effects, and what moves it on. People left over when it ends drift: they keep a routine of their own about a camp, or go on to a town. (0.4.8) Its people come in out of the player's sight ('spawnMin' metres off at least, unseen unless past 'spawnSeen'), lurkers come out after 'patience' seconds with the player near, a herd migrates a 'migrateStride' at a time, and an encounter the player has left 'despawnDistance' behind for 'leftBehind' seconds ends.

robber: Hold there, traveller. This stretch of the King's Road has a toll.
That's far enough. The road's ours, and so's the toll.

dialog.speaker: robber
dialog.text: Your purse, or we take it off your body. A tenth of what you carry and you walk on with your teeth.

choices.text: Walk away from me while you still can.

robber: A pleasure. Mind the road, it's full of thieves.

effects: rumor:paid a highwayman's toll on the King's Road

robber: Not worth the knife. Get gone.
Easy - easy. We'll find softer purses.

effects: rumor:cut down the highwaymen of the King's Road
honor:5:survived an ambush in the dark
rumor:beat off an ambush on the night road

dialog.speaker: guide
dialog.text: Well met. The road bends wide here - I know a shorter way through the scrub, if you'd walk with me. Safer than the open road, these days.

choices.text: You've the look of a cutpurse. Who's waiting in the scrub?

guide: Then we'll do it the hard way. Now, lads!

effects: honor:4:turned a trap on its setters
rumor:turned the tables on a false guide and his friends

dialog.speaker: traveller
dialog.text: Good day to you. Mind how you go - {rumor}

traveller: To {destination}, and with luck before dark.

dialog.speaker: pedlar
dialog.text: Bread, a torch for the dark stretches, bait for the rivers - all honest, all cheap. Take a look?

courier: Make way! Letters for the crown!

dialog.speaker: pilgrim
dialog.text: Jaehaerys keep you, friend. We walk to the sanctuary to hear the names of our dead read out. A coin or a crust for the road would be a kindness.

effects: rumor:gave alms to pilgrims on the road

pilgrim: The Sun light your road. We'll speak your kindness at the altar.

hurt: Over here... please. They took my purse and left me for the crows.

dialog.speaker: hurt
dialog.text: Wolves, or worse - I didn't see. I can't walk on this leg. Have you a bandage, or a bite to eat?

effects: honor:4:tended a stranger by the road

hurt: Bless you. Take this - it's what they didn't find in my boot.

effects: rumor:helped a hurt traveller on the road

creditor: Twelve coins at Midsummer, you swore it before witnesses!
debtor: And the harvest failed! I'll pay at the next fair!

dialog.speaker: creditor
dialog.text: You there - you've an honest face. This man owes me twelve coins and won't pay. A witnessed promise is a promise, is it not?

effects: rumor:settled a carter's debt out of their own purse

choices.text: A failed harvest is no crime. Give him till the fair.
effects: honor:2:spoke for mercy in a debt

choices.text: A promise is a promise. Pay him.

debtor: I... thank you. I won't forget it.

creditor: ...Till the fair, then. Not a day after.

debtor: Fine! Fine. Here. Take it and choke on it.

patrol: Roads are quiet today. Keep them so.
Move along, citizen. And report any outlaws you see.
You're wanted in these parts. Come quietly.

dialog.speaker: prisoner
dialog.text: Please - I took a loaf, that's all, and they'll hang me at the crossroads for it. Cut me loose and I'll vanish, I swear on the Sun.

choices.text: Speak to the escort for them.

effects: rumor:freed a prisoner from the gaolers on the road

escort: ...On your word, then. Go, and don't let me see you again.
The magistrate decides, not you. Stand aside.

dialog.speaker: runner
dialog.text: They're after me - I owe a lord's reeve, nothing more! If they ask, you never saw me. Please!

dialog.speaker: hunters
dialog.text: A man ran this way - lean, grey cloak, owes the reeve. Which way did he go?

dialog.speaker: hunter
dialog.text: Your face is on a board in town, friend, with a price under it. Come along and we'll both live to see the gaol.

choices.text: Here - take this and forget my face.

hunter: Never saw you. The next one might not be so reasonable.

effects: rumor:killed a bounty hunter who came for them
rumor:slew an assassin sent after them

taken: Help! Somebody, please! They're taking me!

dialog.speaker: takers
dialog.text: Keep walking. She's a debtor of the Count's, and none of yours.

taken: You came for me. I'll tell everyone in town.

effects: rumor:freed a captive from slavers on the road

encounters.title: Outlaws and the watch at blows

watch: That's the last of them. Our thanks if you lent a hand.

effects: rumor:the watch beat off outlaws on the road
rumor:beat off a goblin raiding party

hunters: Good timing, if that was you. The Hollow's been spitting these out all season.
